title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: loading charges on the account before a remittance is applied
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, two conditions stand before a remittance is applied to an acceptance whose goods have been loaded:

Every dangerous-goods surcharge that fell due when the goods were loaded is booked before a remittance is applied.

The marine pollutant surcharge of goods loaded as marine pollutant is on the account before any remittance is applied to them.

## Condition → handling
| Situation on the acceptance | Remittance applied |
|---|---|
| a surcharge that fell due at loading is on the account | the condition is met |
| a surcharge that fell due at loading is not on the account | not applied while it is missing |
| goods loaded as marine pollutant, marine pollutant surcharge on the account | the condition is met |
| goods loaded as marine pollutant, marine pollutant surcharge not on the account | not applied while it is missing |

## Points of judgement
- *The goods have not been loaded — does either condition stand?* Both conditions concern charges that fall due at loading; neither is stated for goods that have not been loaded.
